title: Lake Mead Dropped To Just 27% Full
hook: America's biggest reservoir is disappearing in plain sight, and the power could go next.
closing: If the water keeps falling, Hoover Dam stops making power, and everyone relying on it feels that.
question: Did you know Lake Mead dropped this low?

segments.say: In 2000, Lake Mead was nearly full. By 2022 the water had sunk about 150 feet.
Lake Mead held 37% of its capacity in 2016. Six years later, it was barely over a quarter full.
By 2022, Lake Mead sat only 97 feet above the level where Hoover Dam stops making power.
